ऋत्वम् /ṛtvam/ 

rtvam n. zeitiger Same / timely semen; formell = aw.
ər Þwa- würdig, zu ștúh. Pisani, RSO 14, 85.

ऋत्विक्, ऋत्विज्- /ṛtvik/ /ṛtvij-/ 

rtvík, ștvij- zur rechten Zeit opfernd, m. Priester /
sacrificing at the proper time, m. priest, aus *;tu-új-, zu ṣtúḥ, yájati.

ऋत्वियः /ṛtviyaḥ/ 

rtviyaḥ regelmäßig / regular, proper, = aw. raÞwyö, zu ștúh. Vgl. noch ștvíyā . . . vácah RV I, 190, 2: aw. raÞwya vača.
